from docx import Document
from docx.shared import Pt, Inches, RGBColor
from docx.enum.text import WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH
from docx.enum.table import WD_TABLE_ALIGNMENT
from docx.oxml.ns import qn
from docx.oxml import OxmlElement

def new_doc():
    d = Document()

    sec.left_margin = sec.right_margin = Inches(1)
    sec.top_margin = sec.bottom_margin = Inches(1)
    st = d.styles["Normal"]

    st.element.rPr.rFonts.set(qn("w:eastAsia"), "Times New Roman")
    st.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(6)
    for name, size in [("Heading 1", 13), ("Heading 2", 12), ("Heading 3", 11.5)]:
        h = d.styles[name]; h.font.name = "Times New Roman"; h.font.size = Pt(size)
        h.font.bold = True; h.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(0x1F, 0x2A, 0x44)
        h.element.rPr.rFonts.set(qn("w:asciiTheme"), "") if False else None
        rf = h.element.rPr.rFonts
        for a in ("w:ascii", "w:hAnsi", "w:eastAsia", "w:cs"):
            rf.set(qn(a), "Times New Roman")
        for a in ("w:asciiTheme", "w:hAnsiTheme", "w:eastAsiaTheme", "w:cstheme"):
            if rf.get(qn(a)) is not None: del rf.attrib[qn(a)]
        h.paragraph_format.space_before = Pt(12); h.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(6)
        h.paragraph_format.keep_with_next = True
    # header/footer
    hp = sec.header.paragraphs[0]
    hp.text = "PRIVILEGED & CONFIDENTIAL — ATTORNEY–CLIENT COMMUNICATION / ATTORNEY WORK PRODUCT"
    hp.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
    for r in hp.runs: r.font.size = Pt(8.5); r.font.bold = True
    fp = sec.footer.paragraphs[0]; fp.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
    r = fp.add_run("Page "); r.font.size = Pt(9)
    _field(fp, "PAGE")
    return d

def _field(p, code):
    r = p.add_run(); r.font.size = Pt(9)
    f1 = OxmlElement("w:fldChar"); f1.set(qn("w:fldCharType"), "begin")
    it = OxmlElement("w:instrText"); it.set(qn("xml:space"), "preserve"); it.text = code
    f2 = OxmlElement("w:fldChar"); f2.set(qn("w:fldCharType"), "end")
    r._r.append(f1); r._r.append(it); r._r.append(f2)

def _runs(p, text):
    # **bold** and _italic_ markup (simple)
    import re
    parts = re.split(r"(\*\*.+?\*\*|\[\[.+?\]\])", text)
    for part in parts:
        if not part: continue
        if part.startswith("**"):
            r = p.add_run(part[2:-2]); r.bold = True
        elif part.startswith("[["):
            r = p.add_run(part[2:-2]); r.italic = True
        else:
            p.add_run(part)

def P(d, text, indent=0, align=None, size=None, after=None):
    p = d.add_paragraph(); _runs(p, text)
    if indent: p.paragraph_format.left_indent = Inches(indent)
    if align == "j": p.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.JUSTIFY
    if align == "c": p.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
    if size:
        for r in p.runs: r.font.size = Pt(size)
    if after is not None: p.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(after)
    return p

def Q(d, text):
    p = d.add_paragraph(); _runs(p, text)
    p.paragraph_format.left_indent = Inches(0.5); p.paragraph_format.right_indent = Inches(0.5)
    for r in p.runs: r.font.size = Pt(10.5)
    return p

def B(d, items, style="List Bullet"):
    for it in items:
        p = d.add_paragraph(style=style); _runs(p, it)
        p.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(3)

def N(d, items):
    B(d, items, style="List Number")

def H(d, text, lvl=1):
    return d.add_heading(text, level=lvl)

def _shade(cell, hexcolor):
    tcPr = cell._tc.get_or_add_tcPr()
    sh = OxmlElement("w:shd"); sh.set(qn("w:val"), "clear"); sh.set(qn("w:color"), "auto"); sh.set(qn("w:fill"), hexcolor)
    tcPr.append(sh)

def T(d, header, rows, widths, size=9.5):
    t = d.add_table(rows=1, cols=len(header))
    t.style = "Table Grid"; t.alignment = WD_TABLE_ALIGNMENT.CENTER
    t.autofit = False
    for i, h in enumerate(header):
        c = t.rows[0].cells[i]; c.text = ""
        p = c.paragraphs[0]; r = p.add_run(h); r.bold = True; r.font.size = Pt(size)
        _shade(c, "D9E2F3")
    for row in rows:
        cells = t.add_row().cells
        for i, v in enumerate(row):
            cells[i].text = ""
            p = cells[i].paragraphs[0]; _runs(p, str(v))
            for r in p.runs: r.font.size = Pt(size)
            p.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(0)
    for row in t.rows:
        for i, w in enumerate(widths):
            row.cells[i].width = Inches(w)
    # repeat header row
    trPr = t.rows[0]._tr.get_or_add_trPr(); th = OxmlElement("w:tblHeader"); th.set(qn("w:val"), "true"); trPr.append(th)
    d.add_paragraph().paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(2)
    return t
